Automation of repetitive tasks has allowed our team to focus on more strategic work instead of routine support activities. Additionally, improved asset management has helped us better track and utilize resources, avoiding unnecessary purchases.

From a metrics perspective, we’ve seen improvements in key service desk KPIs such as reduced average resolution time, increased first-call resolution rate, and better SLA compliance. The reporting and analytics capabilities have also enabled data-driven decision-making, helping us continuously optimize performance and identify areas for improvement.

Overall, Freshservice has enhanced productivity, improved service quality, and provided better control and visibility across IT operations.

Freshservice has become the central system of record for our IT service management operations. It has standardized how incidents, service requests, and changes are logged, tracked, and resolved, which has improved consistency, visibility, and accountability across the team.
Operationally, Freshservice has reduced manual coordination and email‑driven work by providing a single intake channel, clear ownership, and defined workflows. This has improved response times, reduced duplicate work, and made it easier to identify trends and recurring issues. Reporting and dashboards give leadership better insight into workload, ticket aging, and service performance without requiring custom tooling.
From a cost and efficiency perspective, consolidating ITSM processes into a single platform has reduced operational overhead and tool sprawl. Automation, standardized request forms, and self‑service capabilities have helped shift routine work away from technicians, allowing the team to focus on higher‑value tasks rather than administrative triage.
In terms of outcomes, we’ve seen improvements in ticket visibility, SLA adherence, and overall service consistency. While exact metrics vary by area, Freshservice has supported measurable improvements such as faster time‑to‑resolution, better asset‑to‑ticket traceability, and improved end‑user experience through clearer communication and status transparency.
Overall, Freshservice is a business‑critical platform for our IT organization and a key enabler of scalable, repeatable service management practices.
